issues: 覆盖只涉及固定精确 lock、有限构造的 cell/交易、固定高度 block filter 和分组交易查询；完整结果指该查询范围。有限深度与输入不能证明所有回滚深度、所有输入或整个数据库。 / EN: Coverage concerns one fixed exact lock, finite constructed cells/transactions, fixed height filtering and grouped queries; complete results refer to that query domain. Finite depths/inputs do not establish all rollback depths, all inputs or whole-database correctness.

cell filtering、txpool overlay、非分组分页、数据库中断、强制崩溃、迁移、性能与其他产品 PR 不在本 slice；未计量 reset_spent_cells 的内部数据库调用次数，接口正确不能证明零内部查询。 / EN: Cell filtering, pool overlay, ungrouped pagination, outages, forced crashes, migrations, performance and other product PRs are outside this slice. Internal reset_spent_cells database-call counts are not measured; correct public behavior does not establish zero internal queries.

等待使用 45 秒 deadline、0.1 秒轮询和每次 RPC 的单次调用/5 秒超时；仅启动阶段重试连接或超时。其他 RPC 异常、节点退出、过期等待和清理失败使测试失败，不被吞掉。分页最多 30 页；这些有限条件不是性能阈值保证。 / EN: Waits use a 45-second deadline, 0.1-second polling and one RPC attempt with a five-second timeout; connection/timeouts are retried only at startup. Other RPC errors, node exits, expired waits and cleanup failures fail the test. Pagination allows at most 30 pages; these finite conditions are not performance guarantees.
